name: TUTE ARRASTRADO
description: Tute arrastrado is a Tute variant for three or four players (with four, the dealer sits out each hand). Thirteen cards each from a 40-card Spanish pack; last card turned for trump. Follow suit and overtake or trump; after winning a trick you may sing 20 or 40 (40 before 20); tute (four kings or four horses) wins the hand outright. Chip payments: 100 or 200 from each opponent, plus 40 or 20 per declaration.

content.text: Tute arrastrado is a Tute variant for three or four players (with four, the dealer sits out each hand). Thirteen cards each from a 40-card Spanish pack; last card turned for trump. Follow suit and overtake or trump; after winning a trick you may sing 20 or 40 (40 before 20); tute (four kings or four horses) wins the hand outright. Chip payments: 100 or 200 from each opponent, plus 40 or 20 per declaration.

Tute originated in Italy as tutti and spread to Spain in the 19th century, becoming one of the country's most popular card games. Tute arrastrado is an individual-play variant for three or four players (with four, the dealer sits out each hand), using the same 40-card Spanish pack and marriage-type scoring; it appears alongside other Tute variants such as corriente, habanero, and subastado in Spanish card-game literature.
Three players, or four with dealer sitting out each hand.
Thirteen cards each, one at a time; last card turned for trump.
